title: reCAPTCHA Enterprise Assessment
description: Schema for a reCAPTCHA Enterprise assessment request and response, used to evaluate risk scores for user interactions.

name.description: The resource name of the assessment (output only)

token.description: The reCAPTCHA token provided by the client-side integration

siteKey.description: The site key that was used to invoke reCAPTCHA

userAgent.description: The user agent from the request

userIpAddress.description: The IP address of the user

expectedAction.description: The expected action for this interaction

RiskAnalysis.description: Risk analysis result for the assessment

score.description: Legitimacy score from 0.0 (likely bot) to 1.0 (likely human)

reasons.description: Reasons contributing to the risk analysis

TokenProperties.description: Properties of the submitted reCAPTCHA token

hostname.description: The hostname of the page where the token was generated

action.description: The action name provided when the token was generated

invalidReason.description: Reason the token is invalid, if applicable
